text: Lion's Mane & Ashwagandha: Lion's mane for focus and ashwagandha for stress are popular, but I don't advise either one, and this protocol doesn't use them. People on forums and YouTube report rare cases where they were left with anhedonia (when nothing feels good anymore) and sexual problems for months after they stopped taking them. These lasting effects haven't been studied yet, but they're the same kind that regulators already warn can follow SSRIs and finasteride.
section: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, the warnings: a new item after the Cognitive Warning
reader: an adult with trauma reading the warnings at the top before starting, who may already take lion's mane or ashwagandha, or be thinking of adding them for focus or stress

checked.still_needed: yes: they learn the kind of effect the reports describe is one regulators already recognize for drugs
